text: 'Make it resilient' isn't a requirement, it's a hope. This video turns the incident into real numbers everyone at Brennan Manufacturing is building toward.

Two separate targets, not one: near-zero data loss and under sixty seconds to recover inside the cluster through BrennanAGListener, versus a slower, honestly-labeled disaster-recovery target measured in hours if the whole site is affected.

"The backup is good" becomes a checkable claim: Test-DbaLastBackup actually restores it to prove that, and an off-site copy lands automatically in brennansqlbackups so one building can't take out both copies.
Every number gets an owner and a cadence -- a timed quarterly failover drill, nightly automated backup verification, and a performance baseline captured before anything changes.
The requirements are signed off. Next: drawing a hard line around what phase one actually delivers.
